name: train-cs-ce
description:
RQ7, training language: the cross-entropy model of RQ6 (`train-cs-sk-ce`) trained on
Czech data only, to measure how training on one language transfers to the other.
Every CNEC 2.0 train example and 20,000 drawn from the OpenPII 1M Czech train split
(about 21,400, against 22,308 for cs+sk), so the language changes and the amount of
data, the steps and every hyperparameter do not. Scored on the Czech and the Slovak
development splits. Its Slovak twin is `train-sk-ce`.
